description: This file defines the PcChargeApi class, which provides an API for constructing, sending, and parsing XML-based requests related to a credit card charging system in the context of the OFBiz framework. It manages XML document creation, validation of input/output fields, and socket communication with a remote server.

classes.name: PcChargeApi
classes.description: Provides methods to create, manipulate, and transmit XML-based payment requests and responses over TCP sockets, tailored for integration with a third-party payment system within the OFBiz ecoystem.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field value in the XML request document after validating it as a permissible input parameter.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified output field from the XML response document.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the internal XML document to a String representation.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the internal XML Document object.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to the configured host and port, sends the XML request, and parses the XML response into a new PcChargeApi instance.
